title: Invent A Courier Then Reuse
tests: Creates a character from words, then preserves its generated design and visual style in two follow-up scenes.

faults.what: The cottage-delivery robot has no visible yellow mailbag or carrying strap, omitting a required identifying accessory.
The supplied robots differ in body proportions and eye detailing: the cottage robot is taller and more elongated, while the mushroom robot is rounder with a more mechanically detailed iris.

judge.summary: The two attractive square storybook scenes depict the requested situations, but the cottage robot lacks her yellow mailbag and the original station picture is unavailable for comparison.

must_haves.item: The initial square illustration shows the robot courier at a recognisable train station.
must_haves.why: The initial train-station illustration is not among the supplied images.

must_haves.item: The robot has a round teal body, exactly one large amber eye, short red boots and a yellow mailbag in all three images.
must_haves.why: Both supplied robots have teal bodies, one large amber eye and short red boots, but only the mushroom scene shows a yellow mailbag.

must_haves.item: The two follow-up images preserve the first robot's specific shape, proportions and design details rather than redesigning her.
must_haves.why: The first robot is not shown for comparison; the two available versions also show some variation in proportions and eye detailing.

must_haves.item: One follow-up shows her delivering a parcel at a cottage door; the other shows her sheltering beneath a giant mushroom with rain visible around it.
must_haves.why: The first supplied scene shows her holding a parcel at a flower-framed cottage doorway; the second places her beneath a giant mushroom amid clearly visible rain.

must_haves.item: Three separate square pictures share a consistent storybook illustration style and contain no text.
must_haves.why: The two supplied pictures are square, text-free storybook illustrations with broadly consistent styling, but the third picture is not available.
